title: Quantifying Availability and Discovery in Recommender Systems via Stochastic Reachability
reasoning: The paper's core contribution is a framework for auditing recommender systems on dimensions of access, discovery, and agency. It explicitly aims to 'detect biases' and diagnose 'systemic biases,' such as popularity bias. These are fundamental ethical considerations in the design and deployment of algorithmic systems, directly relating to fairness and equitable opportunity for users and content creators. The work evaluates systems based on these ethical properties.
